words.def: a way of dealing with a problem or doing a task.
words.book: I don't think that's the best approach.
uses: Email
We suggest a phased approach: replace the batteries first, then upgrade the UPS.
Chat
not sure that's the best approach tbh, client wants it done in one visit
Meeting
I think we need a different approach to overdue payments.
dont: This way is not the best way to solve it.
doo: I don't think that's the best approach.

words.def: matching or agreeing with something, such as a plan, rule or opinion.
words.book: That's not in line with my thinking.
uses: Email
Our new prices are in line with market rates for lithium batteries.
Chat
is this discount in line with our policy? 🤔
Meeting
Our Q3 service revenue is in line with the forecast.
dont: This price is suitable with the market.
doo: This price is in line with the market.

words.def: to join a conversation, often by politely interrupting.
words.book: Excuse me, may I jump in for a moment?
uses: Email
Feel free to jump in on this thread if I've missed anything about the site survey.
Chat
can i jump in here? the VFD was already replaced last week
Meeting
Sorry, may I jump in? The customer already approved that budget.
dont: Can I enter in the talk?
doo: May I jump in for a moment?

words.def: not expected or planned before it happened.
words.book: Due to unforeseen circumstances, I won't be able to attend the meeting.
uses: Email
Due to unforeseen delays at customs, the batteries will arrive next week.
Chat
unforeseen issue at the site, running 30 min late 🙏
Meeting
We've added a 10% buffer for unforeseen costs.
dont: Because of circumstances not expected, I can't come.
doo: Due to unforeseen circumstances, I can't attend.

words.book: I must apologize, but I am unable to be present at the meeting, as I have a pressing deadline that I need to meet.
uses: Email
I have a pressing matter with a client this morning, so I'll join at 11.
Chat
sorry, something pressing came up with the bank, call u later
Meeting
The most pressing issue is the overdue invoices from the hospital.
dont: I have a very hurry deadline.

words.ar: متعارض / في نفس الوقت مع حاجة تانية
words.def: happening at the same time as something else, or disagreeing with it.
words.book: Unfortunately, I won't be able to make it to the meeting, as I have a conflicting obligation that I must attend to.
uses: Email
I have a conflicting appointment on Tuesday; could we move the site visit to Wednesday?
Chat
got a conflicting call at 3, can we push to 4?
Meeting
We've received conflicting reports about the cause of the UPS failure.
dont: I have another meeting in the same time.
doo: I have a conflicting meeting at that time.

pro: I see your point, but I have a different perspective.
upgrade.why: في الاجتماع اعترض بأدب: اعترف برأيه الأول وبعدين قول رأيك بـ ‎different perspective‎.

upgrade.plain: I am not comfortable with this suggestion.
pro: I have reservations about that proposal.
I am not comfortable from this suggestion.
upgrade.why: ‎have reservations about‎ = عندي تحفظات، أهدى من الرفض المباشر.

pro: I didn't catch the last part. Would you mind repeating it?
upgrade.why: ‎I didn't catch …‎ بتحط المشكلة عندك انت مش عند اللي بيتكلم.

upgrade.plain: Sorry for cutting you, I have a question.
pro: I'm sorry to interrupt, but I have a quick question.

upgrade.plain: I want to add another point.
pro: I want to add other point.
I want to put a point more.
I'd like to bring up an additional point.
upgrade.why: ‎bring up‎ = يفتح نقطة جديدة، و‎I'd like to‎ أذوق من ‎I want‎.

upgrade.plain: I can't come to the meeting.
pro: I regret to inform you that I won't be able to attend the meeting.
I can't come to the meeting, sorry.
I will not can attend the meeting.
upgrade.why: في الإيميل الرسمي: ‎I regret to inform you …‎ وبعدها ‎won't be able to attend‎.
